scripts.build: npm run build -w @hellotracks/ht-core && rm -rf dist && rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hellotracks/ht-core && rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hellotracks/ht-core && rm -rf dist && rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.json && sh -c 'node --test $(find dist -name "*.test.js" -print)'
